name: A.S. Dent Shop
title: A.S. Dent Shop | Paintless dent repair in Lubbock, TX
description: Lubbock's original dent shop. We massage hail damage, door dings and creases out from behind, with no paint and no filler. 5.0 on Google from 1230 reviews.
heroAlt: Classic blue Mustang fastback parked outside the A.S. Dent Shop
headline:
Hail damage gone.
Factory paint stays.
intro: Lubbock's original dent shop. We massage hail damage, door dings and creases out from behind, with no paint and no filler.
servicesIntro: From a single door ding to a full hail storm.

services.name: Paintless Hail Repair
services.text: Hail dents worked out from underneath, and we work with your insurance adjuster on your behalf.

services.name: Paintless Dent Removal
services.text: Door dings, fallen-debris dents and more, gently massaged back to original form.

services.name: Free Assessment
services.text: Bring it by for a free look. Assessments run Monday to Friday, 10 to 1 and 2 to 4.

why.name: Lubbock's original dent shop
why.text: Owner Allen Scott trained in paintless dent removal in 1991 and opened the Slide Road shop in 1996.

why.name: Original paint, kept
why.text: No painting, no fillers. You keep the factory finish and the value of your car.

why.name: Insurance handled
why.text: We work with your adjuster on your behalf. A free loaner car comes with hail dent repair.

howTitle: Back to like new in three steps.

steps.name: Call or stop by
steps.text: Get a free assessment at 3034 Slide Road. Tell us about the damage.

steps.name: We handle the details
steps.text: We work with your insurance adjuster and set you up with a loaner for hail repair.

steps.name: Pick it up
steps.text: We remove the dent and you drive away with your original factory paint.

reviews.text: Dropped my mustang off to repair a door ding on my rear quarter panel, a difficult spot to work on and it looks as if nothing ever happened! AS Dent Shop did a fantastic job and will definitely bring my business back if ever needed again.
reviews.name: ExotiiK A.

reviews.text: We took a 2021 Mustang GT with a dented top into AS Dent shop knowing it probably need to be replaced. AS Dent shop took a near  impossible job and made it look new! Great service and high quality work.
reviews.name: Ann C.

reviews.text: I got damage from a hailstorm and was admitted in right away after making my insurance claim. They gave me a realistic estimated time of completion for fixing the damage.
reviews.name: Joaquin

reviews.text: Got a nasty door ding in my new truck it broke my heart. AS Dent shop made it completely disappear and I was happy again.
